evidence.evidence_text: In this paper, we present DeliLaw, a Chinese legal counselling system based on a large language model.
Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved excellent results in a variety of natural language processing tasks, which inspired us that we train a LLM in the legal domain to help legal retrieval.
DeliLaw integrates a legal retrieval module and a case retrieval module to overcome the model hallucination.
